name: dwz
description: 短链与私域活码平台，全栈运行于单个 Cloudflare Worker

scripts.dev: npm run build:web && wrangler dev --config packages/worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --config packages/worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply dwz --local --config packages/worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply dwz --remote --config packages/worker/wrangler.toml
